name: Series Grid
author: technodrome

sections.description:
Series Grid revolutionizes how you display content in WordPress. Choose between three professional layouts – Grid, List or Slider – each fully responsive and customizable.

Key Features

  • Multiple Layouts: Grid (1-6 columns), List and Slider options
  • Mobile-First Design: Perfectly responsive on all devices
  • Advanced Filtering: Show posts by category, tag or custom fields
  • Sorting Options: Order by date, title or randomly
  • Featured Content: Highlight special posts with featured markers
  • Performance Optimized: Lazy loading and clean code
  • Customization: Control colors, sizes, hover effects and more
  • Developer Friendly: Hooks, filters and template overrides

Support

For support, please visit WordPress support forums.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the series-grid folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure settings under Settings → Series Grid
  4. Use the [series_grid] shortcode in posts/pages/widgets

For advanced usage:
[series_grid layout=”slider” categories=”1,2″ count=”8″ orderby=”title”]
sections.faq:
How do I change the default layout?

Go to Settings → Series Grid → Layout Options or use the layout parameter in shortcode:
[series_grid layout=”list”]

Can I show posts from specific categories?

Yes, use the categories parameter with comma-separated IDs:
[series_grid categories=”3,7″]

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes, Series Grid includes .pot file for translations.

How to make posts featured?

Add a custom field _featured_post with value 1 to your posts.
